title: Understanding Total Blocking Time On Main Thread
whatIsHappening: The browser spent measurable time processing JavaScript execution on the main thread during initial page load, delaying user interaction responsiveness.
whyItMatters: Long blocking periods directly delay first input responsiveness (FID/INP), creating sluggish perceived performance for visitors attempting to tap, click, or scroll.
evidenceExplanation: PerfLens recorded a Total Blocking Time of 380ms from lab diagnostic audits, indicating high CPU utilization during script execution.
unknowns: The exact JavaScript task or function responsible requires CPU profile sampling.
Network latency and client-side device performance may vary in field conditions.
